camp=dict(total=int(m[1]),tested=int(m[2]),caught=int(o[1]),uncaught=int(o[2]),timeout=int(o[3]),skipped=int(o[4]))

bt={}
for r in d['results']: bt.setdefault(r['target']['path'],[]).append(r['mutant']['id'])
bt={k:sorted(v) for k,v in sorted(bt.items())}
out=dict(campaign=camp,exported_uncaught_ids=ids,exported_uncaught_by_target=bt,
 kill_rate=dict(numerator=camp['caught'],denominator=camp['caught']+camp['uncaught']),equivalence='not_assessed')
json.dump(out,open('/work/mutation-summary.json','w'),indent=2)
# verify
s=json.load(open('/work/mutation-summary.json'))

print(open('/work/mutation-summary.json').read())

import json,re,os
d=json.load(open('/inputs/mewt-results.json'))
txt=open('/inputs/mewt-status.txt').read()
cw=txt.split('Campaign-Wide Summary:')[1]
m=re.search(r'Mutants:\s*(\d+) total,\s*(\d+) tested',cw); o=re.search(r'Outcomes:\s*(\d+) caught,\s*(\d+) uncaught,\s*(\d+) timeout,\s*(\d+) skipped',cw)
camp=dict(total=int(m[1]),tested=int(m[2]),caught=int(o[1]),uncaught=int(o[2]),timeout=int(o[3]),skipped=int(o[4]))
ids=sorted(r['mutant']['id'] for r in d['results'] if r['outcome']['status']=='Uncaught')
assert len(ids)==len(d['results'])==len(set(ids))
assert all(r['mutant']['id']==r['outcome']['mutant_id'] for r in d['results'])
bt={}
for r in d['results']: bt.setdefault(r['target']['path'],[]).append(r['mutant']['id'])
bt={k:sorted(v) for k,v in sorted(bt.items())}
out=dict(campaign=camp,exported_uncaught_ids=ids,exported_uncaught_by_target=bt,
 kill_rate=dict(numerator=camp['caught'],denominator=camp['caught']+camp['uncaught']),equivalence='not_assessed')
json.dump(out,open('/work/mutation-summary.json','w'),indent=2)
s=json.load(open('/work/mutation-summary.json'))
assert s==out
assert set(s)=={'campaign','exported_uncaught_ids','exported_uncaught_by_target','kill_rate','equivalence'}
c=s['campaign']
assert c['caught']+c['uncaught']+c['timeout']==c['tested'] and c['tested']+c['skipped']==c['total']
assert len(s['exported_uncaught_ids'])==c['uncaught']
assert sorted(sum(s['exported_uncaught_by_target'].values(),[]))==s['exported_uncaught_ids']
print(open('/work/mutation-summary.json').read()); print(sorted(os.listdir('/inputs')))
